decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already captures the required reduction in section and paragraph spacing; no additional layout update or removal is necessary.
The source message independently establishes the one-page cover-letter requirement, which is already represented by its same-message INTRODUCE Event.
Reducing spacing or content to meet the page limit does not change any delivery date, turnaround period, or submission deadline.
The page-reduction approach does not alter the Agua Arc identity or the brand assets to apply.
The source decision does not change the Canva platform, edit access, ownership, asset policy, or reuse rights.
The client's willingness to reduce content during review is a conditional page-limit mitigation and does not change the requirement to integrate the supplied narrative in the fixed section order.
Mentioning content reduction during the client's review does not change the established count of one consolidated revision round.
The spacing and possible narrative-content reductions do not cancel or modify the requirement to integrate the supplied revised tables.
The source decision concerns the separate GreenLatinos RFQ and does not affect the TPEC proposal design requirement.
The page-reduction approach does not change the required final PDF format, file count, email submission method, or export properties.
